description: Successful sign-in. Returns the bearer access token (RS256 JWT the console stores as `Authorization: Bearer`), the opaque refresh token, the access-token lifetime in seconds, and the authenticated user record. The FE computes `expiresAt = Date.now() + expiresIn * 1000` and persists the triple to localStorage.

accessToken.description: RS256 JWT. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer ` followed by this token on subsequent requests.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token. Rotated on every successful refresh.

user.description: The authenticated user record — used to seed the FE user cache after sign-in.

roles.description: Org-scoped role names (e.g. `admin`, `editor`, `viewer`). Empty in MVP; expanded in Phase 2 with team-scoped roles.
